verdict.rationale: Veriff documents native iOS (iOS 15+) and Android (minSdk 26) SDKs, web options (InContext SDK, JS SDK), and React Native and Flutter wrappers. It also documents a built-in front-end verification flow that collects end-user media, so the SDK half of the story is well covered. However, nothing in the pack describes the guided document capture the story centers on. missing for 10: evidence of real-time glare/blur/edge-detection coaching during document capture, evidence of first-try capture success or auto-capture quality checks, independent hands-on corroboration of the capture UX.
